_note: Small static catalog seed (offline tests + demo bootstrap). RE-SOURCED in S5c (2026-06-08) to fairly-accurate, cited figures — every score traces to a benchmark source and every price to a provider pricing doc. PRODUCT FIT: ModelMatch's CI agent is a PR-diff REVIEWER (security/style findings), so the PRIMARY recommendation group is a code-REVIEW benchmark, not an autonomous code-FIXING one. TWO COMPARABILITY GROUPS (the recommender only ever compares rows sharing the same benchmark+metric): (1) PRIMARY 'ci_review' / 'review_score_percent' from CodeReviewBench (https://www.codereviewbench.com) — the group the demo recommends over; (2) SECONDARY 'agentic_coding' / 'pass@1_percent' = SWE-bench Verified, all figures from the Amazon Nova 2 technical report Table 4 (https://assets.amazon.science/c5/3d/84514a224666b5be6de4b43ef4aa/nova-2-0-technical-report2.pdf) — kept for recommender breadth and as the OFFICIAL provenance for low-cost Nova 2 Lite. Claude Haiku 4.5 appears in BOTH groups (a real score in each) — the bridge model. PRICING: input_price_per_mtok / output_price_per_mtok are the real per-MTok split prices the S12 savings engine uses (from provider docs). cost_per_mtok is a BLENDED scalar used ONLY for recommender ranking + display, computed at a 3:1 input:output ratio (a review reads a large diff, emits compact findings): cost_per_mtok = (3*input + output) / 4. BASELINE: 'Claude Sonnet 4.5' (CodeReviewBench #1, 87.1%, $3/$15) is the configured demo baseline and sits in the PRIMARY group (so the recommender reports it as 'configured', not a highest-cost fallback). NOVA: Nova 2 Lite has NO real code-review benchmark score (not on CodeReviewBench). All CITED rows keep that integrity — no real figure is invented. The ONE exception is a deliberately-labeled DEMO row: a Nova 2 Lite CodeReviewBench row carrying a SYNTHETIC review score (68.0) + its REAL $0.85 price, added so the demo can show budget-sensitivity steering the pick (high/cost-leaning -> Nova, medium-low/quality-leaning -> Haiku). It is marked 'ILLUSTRATIVE / DEMO ONLY' in its `source` (the only provenance that reaches the API/chat) so it can never be mistaken for a cited result; Nova also keeps its official SWE-bench Verified row. CodeReviewBench lists 8 models total; we curate to Anthropic+Google (Kimi K2.5 omitted to keep Haiku the clean cost-effective pick — a curation choice, no figure altered). Sub-metrics (coverage/validity/cross-file) are recorded per-row in _provenance, NOT as separate rankable rows (separate metric rows would hijack the dominant comparability group). NOTE: _provenance and this _note are FILE-LOCAL documentation only — CatalogRowIn ignores unknown keys, so they are NOT persisted to the DB or exposed via the API/chat; the only provenance that reaches the API/chat is the persisted `source` field (where the citations live). measured_at = the date these figures were sourced (2026-06-08).
